review_candidates.title: IT Infrastructure & Operational Specialist
review_candidates.description: About the role This role oversees the plant's network infrastructure, systems administration, and IT service delivery. You will manage core network routing, switching, enterprise firewalls, and LAN segmentation; maintain on-premises server hardware, storage area networks, and enterprise virtualization clusters; and provide technical support to ensure site network and infrastructure runs smoothly with minimum downtime. Key responsibilities Network & Security Management Network Infrastructure: Oversee the plant's core network routing, switching, enterprise firewalls (e.g., Cisco ), and Local Area Network (LAN) segmentation. Connectivity & Troubleshooting: Diagnose and resolve user connectivity issues, including local network drops, office/plant Wi-Fi, and secure VPN connections. Infrastructure Support: Support diverse IT infrastructure connections including WAN (leased lines, ADSL, ISDN, dial-up), Wireless LAN, and LAN. Monitoring & Compliance: Actively monitor Proxy, Firewall, and Antivirus activities across regional offices to maintain security standards – along with Group IT support Industrial Networking: Apply knowledge of Industrial Ethernet and Layer 2/3 switches to bridge corporate IT and manufacturing plant environments. ( not mandatory but can be plus point ) Systems Administration & Virtualization Server Architecture: Maintain on-premises server hardware, storage area networks ( SAN/NAS ), and enterprise virtualization clusters (e.g., VMware vSphere, Microsoft Hyper-V ) Terminal & Thin Client Management: Supervise the deployment, configuration, and maintenance of plant office hardware, client terminals, industrial thin clients , and peripherals. VDI & Citrix Support: Provision, troubleshoot, and optimize virtual desktops and application delivery within the Citrix environment for shift workers and plant operators. Directory & Network Services: Manage active server environments, domain controllers, Active Directory (AD) , Group Policies, and DNS/DHCP services to guarantee high availability for corporate and plant applications. Cloud & Collaborative Tools: Manage the M365 Admin portal and Azure environments; support Microsoft SharePoint Folders, Print Servers, and File Servers. Performing, checking and monitoring backup operations (daily, system & images backups of AWA). User Lifecycle: Process user onboarding and off-boarding requests based on HR notifications via the ITNow service. Service Desk & Change Control Level 1 & 2 Support: Provide high-quality technical troubleshooting for hardware, Windows operating systems, secure VPN connections, email profiles, and standard office applications. SLA & Queue Management: Manage the local IT service helpdesk queue, ensuring incidents are logged accurately, resolved within agreed SLAs , and escalated efficiently. Testing & Deployment: Conduct thorough system, hardware, and software testing prior to any new site implementations or upgrades (OS, patches, antivirus definitions, hardware swaps) – as and when required only Procurement, Vendor & Asset Management SAP Procurement: Generate and track Purchase Requests (PR) via SAP (minimum basic knowledge required) . Financial Coordination: Coordinate budgetary approvals for IT service contracts, software renewals, and hardware purchases while meticulously tracking every transaction. Inventory Accuracy: Maintain accurate physical labelling and up-to-date documentation of all IT hardware and software assets in the IMS system , including the filing/scanning of purchasing records. Ensure up-to-date documentation on IT assets (such as hardware and software inventories) into IMS system. Vendor Operations: Act as the primary local contact to manage external service providers, ISPs (Metro E), Telco vendors (Mobile Lines), and IP Phone services & VIOP. About you Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or equivalent At least 8 years’ relevant working experience in networking and EUC Knowledge of Industrial Ethernet and Layer 2/3 switches to bridge corporate IT and manufacturing plant environments Minimum basic knowledge of SAP procurement required Ability to provide high-quality technical troubleshooting for hardware, Windows operating systems, secure VPN connections, email profiles, and standard office applications Experience managing IT service helpdesk queue, ensuring incidents are logged accurately and resolved within agreed SLAs Ability to conduct thorough system, hardware, and software testing prior to new site implementations or upgrades Experience maintaining accurate physical labelling and documentation of IT hardware and software assets Ability to act as primary local contact to manage external service providers, ISPs, Telco vendors, and IP Phone services

We deliver industry-leading offensive and defensive cybersecurity alongside full-stack IT services that are integrated by design — protecting, powering, and accelerating our clients’ success. Our teams operate at the intersection of security and technology, combining deep technical expertise with a holistic, client-centered approach. At RedHelm, we are building an environment where innovation, accountability, and collaboration drive meaningful outcomes, both for our clients and for the professionals who support them. Our Professional Services team provides gold standard project management and execution services to RedHelm's clients. The Systems Engineer II executes on the technical Scope of Work for projects, assists the Project Manager with providing progress updates to the client on a weekly basis, and proactively identifies and reports potential issues with the completion of projects. and procedural questions for less experienced team members, teach improved processes, and mentor team members Assist Technical Account Managers with project reviews during the scoping process Perform device firmware Assist with and execute on network switch and server room cable management Complete physical setup and configuration of servers, SANs, firewalls, switches, and access points Work closely with vendors to ensure the proper execution of software/hardware implementation Recognize changes to Scope of Work and alert the Project Manager Ensure quality standards are met by completing Quality Assurance checks of completed projects Required Experience 5+ years of relevant experience Proven experience managing and executing technical IT projects Soft Skill Requirements Excellent customer service skills Excellent verbal and written communication skills Strong interpersonal skills and a willingness to work with others Ability to work through a variety of methods including email, Microsoft Teams, telephone, and face-to-face Strong analytical, evaluative, and problem-solving abilities with the ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment Ability to learn and willingness to take on more complex tasks Ability to diligently create and maintain clear and concise documentation Ability to clearly relay technical data to non-technical individuals Proven ability to work successfully with limited supervision Experience with ticketing systems a strong plus Technical Skill Requirements Strong experience working with cloud service platforms, including Azure and Microsoft 365 (tenant management and configuration) Hands-on experience implementing and troubleshooting Windows Server OS, Active Directory, on-premise Exchange, Group Policy, Microsoft SQL, and DNS issues Experience with implementation and management of VMware ESXi and vSphere/vCenter; experience with other hypervisor technologies a plus Strong experience with Cisco Meraki setup, management, and network configuration Working knowledge of VLANs, firewall configuration, and subnetting Familiarity with Single Sign-On and MFA implementation; knowledge of OneLogin and DUO a plus Preferred Qualifications Technology-related Bachelor's or Associate's degree, or equivalent IT experience Additional Information Travel to customer sites may be required Valid driver's license and reliable transportation required Must be able to successfully pass state and federal background checks Information Security Commitment This role operates within a managed services environment and will have access to client systems, data, and infrastructure. All team members are expected to handle client and company information responsibly, follow established security and data privacy procedures, and support our commitment to maintaining the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the systems we manage. Candidates should be comfortable working within a security-conscious culture where following documented processes and protecting client data are core expectations of the job. Equal Opportunity Employer RedHelm provides equal employment opportunity (EEO) to all persons regardless of age, color, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, genetic information, marital status, status with regard to public assistance, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. Why Join Us This is an exciting time to join RedHelm as we continue to grow and innovate as a full-stack technology partner. Our integrated approach to offensive security, defensive operations, and IT services creates opportunities to work on complex challenges that directly impact the organizations we serve. As we expand our capabilities and footprint, our team members play a meaningful role in shaping what comes next. We are equally committed to investing in our people. We believe in a culture where we care about individuals not just for their professional ambitions, but for their personal goals as well. We recognize that work is part of a larger purpose in each person’s life, and that philosophy drives how we support growth, flexibility, and long-term development across our organization. Engineer network solutions utilizing Cisco, Palo Alto, VMware NSX-T/AVI, F5 including complex BGP configurations. review_candidates.title: Azure Databricks Engineer
review_candidates.description: We are looking for a Azure Databricks Engineer to work on remote from Mexico for a multicultural project with stability and growth in the short, medium and long term. Overview We are seeking a Senior Cloud Engineer to design, implement, and administer the Azure infrastructure behind our enterprise data and AI platform. This is a cloud infrastructure and platform engineering position centered on Azure Databricks, ADLS Gen2, Azure Data Factory, and Azure Machine Learning. You will own the platform foundation — infrastructure as code, network and identity architecture, compute governance, observability, and cost management — and partner closely with our Databricks administration, data engineering, and data science teams. Our group defines the platform standards and reference architectures those teams build within, which means depth in Databricks administration matters here as much as depth in Azure. You should be equally at home provisioning a workspace through Terraform and advising on Unity Catalog design, cluster policy, or identity federation. This role suits an engineer who enjoys being the technical reference point for a platform: setting the architectural direction, partnering with adjacent teams on complex problems, and translating business requirements into the platform capabilities needed to support them. Part One — Infrastructure Ownership Design, implement, and administer the Azure foundation the platform runs on. • Infrastructure as Code (Terraform-first): Author and maintain the reusable Terraform modules that provision the Azure data estate — Databricks workspaces, ADLS Gen2, Data Factory, Key Vault, networking, and Azure ML. Own remote state, module versioning, drift detection, and the pipelines that deploy them. • Network & Security Architecture: Design and implement the private networking and security posture for the platform — private endpoints, hub-and-spoke topology, VNet injection, NSGs and firewall rules, managed identities, Key Vault-backed secret scopes, RBAC, and data exfiltration controls. • Data Lake Infrastructure: Own ADLS Gen2 at the infrastructure layer: storage account architecture, hierarchical namespace, container and ACL strategy, lifecycle and tiering policy, encryption and key management, and access patterns for Databricks and downstream consumers. • Data Factory Platform Operations: Own ADF from the platform side — integration runtime provisioning and scaling (self-hosted and managed VNet), linked service credential and managed identity design, environment promotion, deployment automation, and monitoring. Pipeline development sits with the data engineering team. • AI/ML Platform Infrastructure: Provision and operate the infrastructure supporting machine learning workloads: Azure ML workspaces and compute clusters, GPU quota and capacity planning, MLflow model registry integration, model serving endpoints, and the identity and networking connecting them to Unity Catalog. • Observability & Reliability: Build and maintain the monitoring layer — Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, diagnostic settings, alerting, and operational runbooks across the estate. • FinOps & Capacity Planning: Own cost visibility and optimization across DBU and storage spend — tagging strategy, chargeback and showback, budget alerts, reserved capacity, and forward capacity planning. • CI/CD & Environment Management: Own the deployment pipelines and promotion path across development, test, and production environments. Part Two — Databricks Platform Administration Day-to-day Databricks operations are supported by a dedicated administration team. This role establishes the platform standards and reference configurations that team works from, and serves as a senior technical partner on architecture, design decisions, and complex escalations. That partnership requires genuine administrative depth across the following areas. • Account & Workspace Administration: Account console configuration, workspace provisioning and topology decisions, workspace-level settings, admin role delegation, and multi-workspace strategy. • Unity Catalog: Metastore design and regional strategy, catalog/schema/table permission models, storage credentials and external locations, Hive metastore migration, lineage and audit, and Delta Sharing configuration. • Identity & Access: Entra ID integration, SCIM provisioning, identity federation, groups and entitlements, service principals, and token policy. • Compute Governance: Cluster policies, instance pools, node type and runtime standards, autoscaling and autotermination enforcement, Photon and serverless evaluation, and SQL warehouse sizing and configuration. • Cost & Usage Analysis: System tables, usage attribution, and DBU forecasting — with the ability to assess a workspace, identify where spend is concentrated, and recommend a remediation path. • Technical Partnership: Review platform configurations, contribute to design decisions, and support the administration and data teams on issues that span infrastructure and Databricks. Publish the standards, reference configurations, and self-service patterns that allow those teams to move quickly and safely. • Cross-Boundary Diagnostics: Investigate job failures, cluster startup issues, permission errors, connectivity faults, and performance concerns, and determine whether the root cause sits in infrastructure, Databricks configuration, or the workload itself. Role Scope To set clear expectations about how this position divides from adjacent teams: • Production ETL/ELT pipeline development and Spark transformation work sit with the data engineering team. • Model development, training, and tuning sit with the data science team. • Dimensional modeling, dbt development, and BI/semantic layer work sit outside this role. • Day-to-day Databricks administration is handled by a dedicated team; this role provides the standards, architecture, and senior technical partnership behind it. Required Qualifications • Experience: 6+ years in cloud infrastructure or platform engineering, with at least 4 years focused on Microsoft Azure. • Terraform: Expert-level, hands-on. You have authored and maintained production Terraform modules, managed remote state, and run infrastructure as code through CI/CD. This is a core daily skill in this role. • Databricks Administration: Demonstrable hands-on administration experience — account and workspace administration, Unity Catalog, cluster policies, identity federation, and cost governance. You should be able to describe administrative decisions you have made and explain the tradeoffs behind them. • Technical Partnership: A track record as a senior technical resource to adjacent teams, including guiding stakeholders from an initial request to the underlying requirement and building consensus around the recommended approach. • Azure Networking & Security: Deep working knowledge of private endpoints, VNets and hub-spoke design, NSGs, Entra ID, managed identities, RBAC, and Key Vault. • Data Lake Architecture: ADLS Gen2 design and access control at enterprise scale. • Azure Data Factory: Platform-side experience with integration runtimes, managed VNet, credential management, and deployment automation. • Automation & Scripting: Strong Python, plus PowerShell and/or Bash, for platform tooling and automation. • Spark & SQL Literacy: Sufficient working knowledge to diagnose infrastructure and configuration-level performance issues and engage credibly with data teams. Spark development depth is not a requirement for this role. Preferred Qualifications • Databricks Asset Bundles, the Terraform Databricks provider, and workspace-as-code patterns • Experience leading a Unity Catalog migration or multi-workspace consolidation • Azure Machine Learning, MLflow, or model-serving infrastructure experience • Kubernetes / AKS and containerized workloads • Policy as code — Azure Policy, OPA, Sentinel, or Checkov • Event-driven infrastructure — Event Hubs, Kafka, or Stream Analytics • Formal FinOps practice experience • Multi-region or multi-tenant Databricks deployments Preferred Certifications • Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional, or a Databricks platform administrator credential • Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305) • Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104) • Microsoft Certified: DevOps Engineer Expert (AZ-400) • HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate" Offer: Payroll Superior Benefits Direct hire by client Multicultural teams Full remote Job If you are looking for a new professional challenge, this is a good opportunity, let's talk about your next professional experience.

Wenn Du Spaß an Design und Implementierung von Cloud Technologien wie Microsoft 365 und insbesondere den Themen Modern Workplace und Endpoint Management und dabei neuste Trends und Technologien vorantreiben möchtest, dann passt Du sehr gut zu uns! Das Jahresbruttogehalt für diese Position beginnt gemäß IT-Kollektivvertrag, abhängig von Qualifikation und Erfahrung, bei 70.000€ auf Vollzeitbasis Was ist Deine Rolle im Team Entwicklung der Architekturen für eine Cloud-basierte Endpoint Management Lösung auf Basis von Microsoft 365. Mitarbeit in der Fokus-Gruppe für Endpoint Management sowie Einbringung neuer Ideen und punktuelle Reviews anderer Projekte als Fachexpert:in. Mitglied eines größeren Teams, das in einem Modernisierungsprojekt, oder einem Carve-Out eine neue Plattform entwirft, aufbaut und ausrollt. Verantwortung der Kundenschnittstellen im Sinne einer Teilprojektleitung oder der Architektur -- zumeist vor Ort. Im Normalfall arbeitest Du für mehrere Wochen oder Monate für ein Projekt und kannst dich voll und ganz darauf konzentrieren und viel Wissen aufbauen. Aktive Unterstützung der Presales- und Sales-Prozesse, indem Du beispielsweise beim Erstellen von Angeboten oder in Webcasts mitwirkst. (Das derzeitge IT-KV-Mindestgehalt ÖSTERREICH (2024) beträgt €43.078 - €71.848 (Vollzeitbasis) abhängig von der Einstufung) Erfahre mehr über einige unserer Vorteile hier. Der perfekte Ort zum Arbeiten Wenn du dich dafür entscheidest, deine Fähigkeiten und individuellen Talente bei Avanade einzubringen, wirst du im Gegenzug einzigartige Erfahrungen, unbegrenzte Lernmöglichkeiten und ambitioniertes Wachstum erleben. Und während wir auch weiterhin in unsere vielfältige und inklusive Kulturinvestieren, dabei noch innovativer und kreativer werden, sorgen wir dafür, dass unsere Kund:innen von unseren technischen Innovationen profitieren und es unseren Communities gut geht. Du wirst Teil eines smarten Teams, das dich unterstützt, fördert, leitet und auf deine Expertise baut. Der perfekte Start in einem Unternehmen, das gegründet wurde, um geschäftskritische, führende Technologielösungen zu implementieren und gleichzeitig die Art und Weise, wie Menschen arbeiten, interagieren und leben verbessern möchte. Das klingt nach einen Ort an dem du arbeiten möchtest? Dann schau dir unsere weiterführenden Informationen an. Wir arbeiten kontinuierlich daran eine noch inklusivere und diversere Unternehmenskultur zu schaffen die allen Kolleg:innen ein tiefgehendes Zugehörigkeitsgefühl ermöglicht. Besuche unsere Inclusion & Diversity Seite um mehr zu erfahren.

review_candidates.title: Cloud Operations Engineer (Modernisation & Move to Cloud)
review_candidates.description: Créé en 1999, le Groupe Meilleurtaux est devenu un acteur de référence des services financiers en France, couvrant les domaines du placement, du crédit et de l’assurance. Chaque année, nous accompagnons près de 3 millions de Français , et plus de 20 millions de personnes ont déjà fait appel à nos services. Notre force repose sur un modèle unique combinant une plateforme digitale de premier plan (28 millions de visiteurs par an) et un réseau de près de 300 agences de proximité , au service de parcours clients simples, transparents et performants. En 2025, notre activité représente plus de 5 milliards d’euros de crédits immobiliers débloqués et 6 milliards d’euros d’actifs gérés sur l’épargne . Avec 1 500 collaborateurs à l'échelle globale , nous portons une culture fondée sur la transparence, l’agilité et la liberté d’initiative , au service de l’engagement des équipes et de l’innovation collective. 🎯 Notre mission : rendre la finance plus accessible pour permettre à chacun d’être libre de ses choix. Rejoindre Meilleurtaux, c’est intégrer un groupe solide, en croissance, et participer activement à un projet porteur de sens et d’impact. Description du poste Contexte Plusieurs projets de migration d'infrastructures OnPrem complexes vers Azure sont en cours au sein des équipes du groupe, avec un enjeu fort de modernisation des applications concernées. L'équipe Engineering Platform porte par ailleurs l'architecture cloud hub & spoke et les landing zones mises à disposition des équipes. Nous recherchons un Cloud Operations Engineer pour accompagner ces équipes dans leur migration vers Azure et leur modernisation, et contribuer à l'exploitation de ces environnements dans la durée. Missions Vous accompagnez plusieurs équipes dans la migration vers Azure de leurs infrastructures OnPrem complexes : analyse de l'existant, contribution à la conception de la cible d'architecture en cohérence avec le hub & spoke et les landing zones, participation à l'exécution des plans de migration. Vous participez aux travaux de modernisation de ces environnements une fois migrés : conteneurisation des applications, refonte des dépendances, remplacement des composants legacy par des services managés Azure, optimisation des architectures applicatives. Vous contribuez au maintien en condition opérationnelle (MCO) des infrastructures migrées et modernisées : supervision, patching, gestion des incidents, optimisation des coûts et des performances. Demonstrates advanced proficiency in the ability to work independently and communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders Any combination of experience and training which provides the equivalent scope of knowledge, skills, and abilities necessary to perform the work.. Preferred Qualifications Experience with Microsoft 365, Windows environments, or user account administration. Experience in healthcare, public health, or regulated environments. Exposure to basic workflow documentation, process observation, or requirements gathering preferred. Experience with process improvement and/or solution implementation. Required Certificates, Licenses, Registrations Valid Montana driver license (travel between RSH sites may be required). Required to obtain emergency preparedness on the job training at a minimum of ICS 100, 200, and 700. Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities Working knowledge of common desktop hardware, peripherals, Windows operating systems, and Microsoft 365 productivity tools. Ability to learn department operations, workflows, and how technology supports service line needs. Strong customer service skills, sound troubleshooting methodology, and good documentation habits; works effectively with users of varying technical ability. Ability to observe a workflow, identify where it breaks down, and describe the problem clearly in writing. Ability to prioritize multiple requests, manage time, and follow through on routine tasks. Knowledge of HIPAA privacy, security, confidentiality requirements, and best practices Ability to follow technical standards, escalation procedures, and change management practices set by I&R governance. Customer Service Excellence Doing things right the first time Making people feel welcome Showing respect for each customer Anticipating customer needs and concerns Keeping customers informed Helping and going the extra mile Responding quickly Protecting privacy and confidentiality Demonstrating proper telephone etiquette Taking responsibility for handling complaints Being professional Taking ownership of your attitude toward Service Excellence. Supervision None Physical Demands And Working Conditions Work is primarily performed in an office or healthcare environment. Requires frequent use of a computer for a substantial portion of the shift. May require lifting, moving, or installing endpoints and peripherals within safe limits. Travel between RiverStone Health locations may be required. Ability to travel and use own personal vehicle. Expected to drive a vehicle which requires sitting, seeing and reading signs, traffic signals, other vehicles, etc. Travel occurs in all weather conditions, including extreme heat and cold Must create and maintain a safe and secure work environment by following applicable safety, health, and security procedures. Freedom To Act & Decision Making Works under limited supervision on assigned support, analysis, and implementation responsibilities. Uses independent judgment to assess moderately complex technical and business needs, determine next steps, and coordinate appropriate resources. May recommend or implement approved configuration changes, workflow-supporting adjustments, or standard technical solutions within established governance and change management practices. Leads regular meetings with assigned departments and ensures follow-up items are documented and advanced appropriately. Communications & Networking Daily written and verbal communication with other technology teams. Responsible for handling sensitive business and protected health information appropriately. review_candidates.description: Job Description: Business Overview Mission Rakuten Group's basic management philosophy is to "empower people and society through innovation." We provide more than 70 diverse services, including EC services such as shopping malls and travel booking sites, financial services such as online banking, and media services and professional sports, to more than 100 million customers in Japan alone (more than 1 billion globally), covering a wide range of people's life scenes. At the same time, we are building a strong business model based on the "Rakuten Ecosystem" that organically links customers and various services. As a member of the Rakuten Group's FinTech Group Company, we at Rakuten Payment, Inc. are developing businesses centered on settlement services such as Rakuten Pay, Rakuten Edy, and Point Partner Business, as well as marketing solutions. "With the power of technology, we aim to create a world where anyone can enjoy the same value no matter where they are." As the digital sphere of society rapidly expands, we want to connect the Internet and the real world more seamlessly, so that everyone can use technology to lead a safe, secure, and more comfortable daily life. In order to achieve such a society, we would like to face the various problems that people are facing and move forward together to the next stage. Department Overview Features and Strengths With the strength of the Rakuten Point market, which has surpassed 3 trillion yen in total issuance, we are building the "Rakuten Economic Circle" through service collaboration with Rakuten Group companies and the introduction of cashless settlement services in real stores, which are growing at an accelerated pace. Our settlement services can be used at approximately 5 million online and offline locations, including supermarkets, convenience stores, and shopping malls nationwide, as well as at approximately 1 million locations where traffic-related e-money can be used, and the number of locations where this service can be used is continuing to expand. In recent years, the cashless payment market has rapidly expanded worldwide, and our service "Rakuten Pay" has also been growing its performance domestically. Consequently, the importance of the digital infrastructure as a mission-critical payment platform, including its public utility, sophistication, and convenience, has been increasing day by day. This necessitates the establishment of a dynamic multi-cloud environment and the assurance of stable operation across these services. Rakuten Pay Service Operations Group has the mission that “ ‘pursuing’ Rakuten Pay that can be used ‘Atari-mae’-ly” Position: Why We Hire Along with the growth of our business, the scope of Rakuten Pay's service operations are expanding, and we are looking for new members to join our team. By taking charge of service operation that handles a large amount of traffic, from the Rakuten Pay app to the payment platform to linking with external services, you will have the opportunity to cultivate rare operation skills and knowledge of payment infrastructures and the ability to ensure stable operation of service. Position Details Job Description In order to ensure the stable operations of Rakuten Pay services, so that users and merchants can utilize our services with safety and confidence, we will ask you to work as a system engineer, conducting service operation and identifying improvements for service operation and maintenance. Service operation includes the necessary tasks to maintain service, such as service monitoring, trouble investigation and management, and regular operation. In order to carry out these operations, it is necessary to collaborate with other departments, such as those in charge of backend and mobile development and other service operations. As such this position requires a high level of communication skills. While maintenance and operations may sound simple, Rakuten Pay's users, affiliated stores, and services continue to expand on a daily basis, and as such constant improvement to our platform is necessary to ensure a smooth continuity of high-level service. Many of our members come from abroad, so you will have the chance to improve your English communication skills as well. Responsibilities Management of service operations: Arrange, negotiate each operation tasks from internals / externals (incl. resource managements) Promotes activities for troubleshooting and improvement activities Improvements Of Service Operation Tasks: Make a plan and Promotion and Managements for improvements for service availability and mandatory task for service continuity Discover issues, includes not only tangible but also potential, on our services and improvement activities On-call night duty required (approximately once a week) This is a potential Engineering Leader position for the Service Operations Group. Rewarding tasks through service operations By understanding actual behaviors and working on improvements, you can contribute to enhancing service quality. Modern architecture You will work with modern architecture utilizing cloud-native technologies and Kubernetes (k8s). Collaboration with a global team. You will collaborate with international members, including those in India, and work from a global perspective. Stakeholders Backend and mobile development teams Development and operations members at overseas locations (India) Maintenance and operations staff of other services Customer support Planning department Operations department Sales department Work Environment The average age across the group is in the mid-30s, with approximately 50 members. More than 90% joined as a mid-carrier. 6 nationalities in members. Some members in Rakuten India. In Japan members, Many of them come from system vendors or user companies of web services that experienced any of from design to operation phases. In India members , Many of them come from web services or new grads in Rakuten. Mandatory Qualifications: 3+ years system maintenance and operation experience 3+ years experience developing backend applications Team Leading experience (including project leading ) Desired Qualifications: Experience with mission-critical services Experience in developing and operating services with large-scale users Experiences of BtoB services Fintech domain knowledge (especially electronic payment services) Experience using Atlassian collaboration tools (JIRA, Confluence, etc.) RDBMS, App Server knowledge and experience Experience in improving operational efficiency Experience in trouble shooting / managing improvements Additional information on Location NBF Shinagawa Tower Additional Information On Secondment This position will be hired by Rakuten Group, Inc. and seconded to Rakuten Payment, Inc. #engineer #jobcategory02 #fintechgroup #operationengineer #organization05 #RakutenPay #servicename35 #RakutenPayment Languages: English (Overall - 2 - Intermediate), Japanese (Overall - 3 - Advanced)

Monitor node and database performance, troubleshoot latency bottlenecks, and scale server resources (CPU, RAM, Storage) to meet mission demands. Assist designated system owners with maintaining operating status and documentation. new_matches.title: Senior Network Engineer
new_matches.description: SUMMARY The Senior Network Engineer is responsible for designing, implementing, maintaining, and troubleshooting enterprise and datacenter network infrastructure. This role serves as a senior technical resource and escalation point for complex network issues, supporting high-availability environments and ensuring network performance, reliability, and security. The ideal candidate has strong hands-on experience with routing and switching, BGP, Juniper network technologies, and datacenter environments. Experience with network design, security appliances, network overlays, and automation is highly valued. JOB RESPONSIBILITIES Design, implement, configure, and maintain enterprise and datacenter network infrastructure. Serve as a senior technical escalation point for complex network incidents and issues. Configure and manage routing and switching infrastructure across production environments. Deploy and maintain BGP sessions across WAN, public, and datacenter network environments. Configure and support Juniper EX/QFX switching and SRX security appliances. Provision network services, including servers, firewalls, GRE tunnels, and related connectivity. Investigate and troubleshoot network incidents while minimizing customer impact and service disruption. Work with internal teams, customers, network providers, transit providers, and cross-connect partners to resolve connectivity issues. Participate in network upgrades, migrations, capacity planning, and infrastructure expansion. Support router, switch, uplink, and network resource upgrades. Assist with the deployment of new network locations and points of presence. Follow formal change management processes and participate in Change Advisory Board (CAB) activities. Monitor network performance, availability, capacity, and utilization. Identify opportunities to improve network reliability, performance, scalability, and operational efficiency. Maintain network documentation, configurations, diagrams, and technical procedures. Support incident management and communicate with affected clients through resolution. Stay current with networking technologies, security practices, and industry best practices. Contribute to automation and operational improvements using scripting and network automation tools where applicable. QUALIFICATIONS Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 5+ years of hands-on network engineering experience, preferably in enterprise, datacenter, telecommunications, or financial services environments. Strong technical expertise in routing and switching. Strong hands-on experience with Juniper networking technologies, particularly EX/QFX switches and SRX firewalls. Strong understanding and practical experience with BGP. Experience designing, implementing, and supporting networks in large-scale datacenter and/or metro environments. Strong understanding of network security principles, firewall technologies, and secure network architecture. Experience supporting high-availability and business-critical network environments. Strong understanding of Linux and Windows Server operating systems. Experience troubleshooting complex network connectivity, routing, switching, and performance issues. Ability to work independently on complex technical issues and take ownership from investigation through resolution. Strong communication skills with the ability to work effectively with technical teams, customers, vendors, and service providers. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a focus on minimizing service disruption. Experience with formal change management and CAB processes. JNCIP or equivalent professional-level networking experience preferred. JNCIE or equivalent expert-level experience is highly desirable. Experience with the following is preferred: VXLAN/EVPN. Arista low-latency switching. Packet capture and network traffic analysis. DWDM and optical networking. Network automation. Python or other scripting languages. Experience supporting financial services, trading, or other low-latency datacenter environments is highly preferred. CERTIFICATIONS JNCIP – Juniper Networks Certified Professional or equivalent experience — Preferred. JNCIE – Juniper Networks Certified Internet Expert or equivalent experience — Highly Preferred. Additional networking certifications such as CCNP are advantageous. JOB REQUIREMENTS Should be willing to accept a long-term work-from-home arrangement. Should be amenable to a permanent night shift schedule.

Work with Business Relationship Managers and various lines of business to deploy and secure network aware solutions. Continually determine process, configuration, and deployment efficiencies with automation technologies including Ansible, Terraform, Python, Powershell, Perl, Security/Network Management systems, and homegrown solutions. Firewall configuration, deployment and management (Checkpoint NGFW, Legacy Juniper SSG, Airgap). Check Point GAIA firewalls (DMZ, VPN, IPS, PBR, VSX), Zscaler ZIA, ZPA, and Airgap, F5 Big IP platform (DNS, Load balancing, WAF, iRules), JIRA, Service Now, Cisco ISE (RADIUS & TACACS), WAN technologies and SD-WAN concepts, Certificate Management. Part One — Infrastructure Ownership Design, implement, and administer the Azure foundation the platform runs on. • Infrastructure as Code (Terraform-first): Author and maintain the reusable Terraform modules that provision the Azure data estate — Databricks workspaces, ADLS Gen2, Data Factory, Key Vault, networking, and Azure ML. Own remote state, module versioning, drift detection, and the pipelines that deploy them. • Network & Security Architecture: Design and implement the private networking and security posture for the platform — private endpoints, hub-and-spoke topology, VNet injection, NSGs and firewall rules, managed identities, Key Vault-backed secret scopes, RBAC, and data exfiltration controls. • Data Lake Infrastructure: Own ADLS Gen2 at the infrastructure layer: storage account architecture, hierarchical namespace, container and ACL strategy, lifecycle and tiering policy, encryption and key management, and access patterns for Databricks and downstream consumers. • Data Factory Platform Operations: Own ADF from the platform side — integration runtime provisioning and scaling (self-hosted and managed VNet), linked service credential and managed identity design, environment promotion, deployment automation, and monitoring. From medical, dental and behavioral healthcare; home care and hospice; public health services like immunizations, WIC, health promotion and restaurant inspections; and educating the next generation of health professionals, our expertise spans all ages and stages of life. Underlying principles of access, affordability, compassion and quality in all interactions, RiverStone Health improves life, health and safety for all of the communities we serve. Job Summary The Technical Consultant II provides advanced technical support, business analysis, and technology enablement for assigned departments or service lines. This position serves as a primary liaison between business partners and technical teams, independently assessing moderately complex needs, clarifying requirements, coordinating issue resolution, and supporting the implementation and adoption of technology solutions. The TC II identifies recurring problems, evaluates opportunities for technology-enabled improvement, contributes to standards and documentation, and helps ensure solutions align with I&R governance, security requirements, and organizational priorities. This role functions with greater independence than the Technical Consultant I and may provide guidance, coaching, or escalation support to other technical staff. The TC II operates under I&R governance, coordinates with department leadership, and is the second level of the Technical Consultant career path. Essential Functions/Major Duties And Responsibilities Advanced Technology Integration ~35% Evaluate new and emerging technologies to determine their fit for business needs. Lead or coordinate small to moderately complex technology implementations, enhancements, or department-specific optimization efforts. Participate in solution evaluation, vendor discussions, product demonstrations, and fit-gap conversations when assigned. Identify areas where technology can enhance business processes or solve recurring issues. Coordinate testing activities with department users, including test scenario development, issue tracking, validation, and readiness feedback. Support change readiness by identifying training needs, communication needs, support impacts, and adoption risks before go-live. Partner with application, infrastructure, security, data, and governance teams to ensure proposed solutions align with organizational standards. Track implementation issues, decisions, risks, and follow-up items for assigned technology initiatives. Help evaluate whether implemented solutions achieved the intended business outcome and identify reasonable next steps when they did not. Participate in ongoing learning and contribute to team discussions on process improvements and standardization opportunities Follow RiverStone Health technical standards, security requirements, and documented best practices as defined by I&R governance. Complex Business Analysis ~35% Serve as the primary technology relationship partner for assigned departments or service lines. Lead discovery conversations with department leaders and key users to clarify business needs, define problems, and separate technology issues from operational preference or process variation. Develop clear business and technical requirement summaries for moderately complex technology needs, system changes, reports, integrations, or application enhancements. Help departments evaluate whether a request should be handled as support, training, optimization, configuration, reporting, or formal project work. Translate department needs into structured intake documentation, including business purpose, expected outcome, affected users, risks, dependencies, and success criteria. Facilitate discussions between business partners and technical teams when requirements are unclear, competing, or likely to affect multiple systems. Support prioritization discussions by helping department leaders understand technical complexity, resource needs, and potential tradeoffs. Work closely with technical teams to translate business requirements into actionable technical specifications. Provide end-user instruction and basic training on Microsoft 365 tools, security best practices, HIPAA-compliant use of technology, and approved systems. Technical Support & Issue Resolution ~25% Deliver frontline technical support, addressing tier 1 and tier 2 issues across hardware, software, and network environments. Serve as an escalation resource for complex tier 2 issues that require deeper technical investigation, cross-system troubleshooting, or coordination across multiple technical teams. Lead resolution efforts for assigned technical issues from discovery through closure, including communication with affected users, department leadership, and internal technical teams. Identify patterns in support requests and recommend preventive actions, documentation updates, configuration changes, or training opportunities. Review and improve knowledge base content, support procedures, and troubleshooting guides used by other technical staff. Utilize tools such as ticketing systems, remote diagnostic software, and monitoring platforms to deliver efficient support. Participate in an on-call rotation shared across the technical team. Provide informal coaching to Technical Consultant I staff or other support team members on troubleshooting approach, documentation quality, and customer communication. Non-Essential Functions/Other duties as assigned ≥5% Perform other duties as assigned in support of RiverStone Health’s mission and goals. Education And Experience Minimum Qualifications Associate or bachelor’s degree in information technology, computer information systems, business technology, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience may be considered. Five years of professional experience in technical support, systems support, or a related IT role. Extensive experience supporting end users, managing system changes, creating technical documentation, and working across functional teams. Demonstrates advanced proficiency in the ability to work independently and communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders Any combination of experience and training which provides the equivalent scope of knowledge, skills, and abilities necessary to perform the work.. Preferred Qualifications Experience with Microsoft 365, Windows environments, or user account administration. Experience in healthcare, public health, or regulated environments. Exposure to basic workflow documentation, process observation, or requirements gathering preferred. Experience with process improvement and/or solution implementation. Required Certificates, Licenses, Registrations Valid Montana driver license (travel between RSH sites may be required). Required to obtain emergency preparedness on the job training at a minimum of ICS 100, 200, and 700. Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities Working knowledge of common desktop hardware, peripherals, Windows operating systems, and Microsoft 365 productivity tools. Ability to learn department operations, workflows, and how technology supports service line needs. Strong customer service skills, sound troubleshooting methodology, and good documentation habits; works effectively with users of varying technical ability. Ability to observe a workflow, identify where it breaks down, and describe the problem clearly in writing. Ability to prioritize multiple requests, manage time, and follow through on routine tasks. Knowledge of HIPAA privacy, security, confidentiality requirements, and best practices Ability to follow technical standards, escalation procedures, and change management practices set by I&R governance. Customer Service Excellence Doing things right the first time Making people feel welcome Showing respect for each customer Anticipating customer needs and concerns Keeping customers informed Helping and going the extra mile Responding quickly Protecting privacy and confidentiality Demonstrating proper telephone etiquette Taking responsibility for handling complaints Being professional Taking ownership of your attitude toward Service Excellence. Supervision None Physical Demands And Working Conditions Work is primarily performed in an office or healthcare environment. Requires frequent use of a computer for a substantial portion of the shift. May require lifting, moving, or installing endpoints and peripherals within safe limits. Travel between RiverStone Health locations may be required. Ability to travel and use own personal vehicle. Expected to drive a vehicle which requires sitting, seeing and reading signs, traffic signals, other vehicles, etc. Travel occurs in all weather conditions, including extreme heat and cold Must create and maintain a safe and secure work environment by following applicable safety, health, and security procedures. Freedom To Act & Decision Making Works under limited supervision on assigned support, analysis, and implementation responsibilities. Uses independent judgment to assess moderately complex technical and business needs, determine next steps, and coordinate appropriate resources. May recommend or implement approved configuration changes, workflow-supporting adjustments, or standard technical solutions within established governance and change management practices. Leads regular meetings with assigned departments and ensures follow-up items are documented and advanced appropriately. Communications & Networking Daily written and verbal communication with other technology teams. Responsible for handling sensitive business and protected health information appropriately. Budget & Resource Management This position does not have direct budget or FTE responsibility. Responsible for appropriate stewardship of assigned equipment and resources

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce. As a Slack Proactive Monitoring (ProM) Engineer , you will operate at the intersection of platform engineering, site reliability, and strategic customer success. You are a highly technical, customer-centric specialist dedicated to safeguarding the health and performance of Slack’s largest and most complex global enterprise deployments (Enterprise Grid). Rather than waiting for customers to report problems, you will continuously monitor Slack workspace metrics, performance thresholds, API integrations, enterprise security events, and custom app behavior. You will proactively detect anomalies, triage system exceptions, and orchestrate rapid mitigation steps—frequently initiating preemptive customer outreach before their internal users even experience a slowdown. Key Responsibilities Continuously monitor dashboards, alerting systems, and telemetry data (error rates, latency spikes, API failures, deployment anomalies) for early signals of degradation. Triage and correlate alerts from multiple sources (Splunk, internal tools, etc) to identify patterns before customers report issues. Actively monitor Slack platform health dashboards, network latency signals, message delivery queues, and database capacities for high-frequency workspaces. Monitor critical custom automations, Slack Workflow Builder runs, Enterprise Key Management (EKM) operations, and Identity Provider (IDP) authentication syncs. Identify customers potentially affected by degraded service conditions and coordinate proactive outreach with Customer Success and Support teams. Partner with the Incident Management team to escalate signals that meet incident-threshold criteria. Technical Advisory: Partner with Customer Success Managers and Success Architects to deliver annual technical health check reviews, assessing platform metrics, configuration limits, and custom integration health. Perform root cause analysis (RCA) on proactively detected issues, documenting findings in internal case and incident management systems. Work closely with Engineering and SRE teams to drive rapid remediation of identified issues Intervene in low-risk system exceptions (e.g., advising clients on misconfigured Slack Webhooks, API rate limit exhaustion, or broken Salesforce-Slack app connections) before they trigger widespread downtime. Build and maintain Slack-based automations and workflows to streamline proactive monitoring operations. Requirements 2+ years of experience in technical support, site reliability engineering, or a related operations role. Hands-on experience with observability and monitoring tools (e.g., Grafana, Splunk, Datadog, PagerDuty, or equivalent). Strong understanding of cloud-based SaaS architecture, APIs, and common failure modes. Proficiency in reading and analyzing logs, metrics, and traces. Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to clearly convey technical findings to both technical and non-technical audiences. Demonstrated ability to leverage modern AI tools to optimize workflows, conduct research, and enhance daily productivity. Preferred Requirements Experience working with Slack platform (Slack API, Slack workflows, Bolt framework). Familiarity with Salesforce Service Cloud / OrgCS case management. Scripting or automation experience (Python, JavaScript, Bash). Experience in a customer-facing support engineering or reliability role at a SaaS company. ITIL, SRE, or similar certification.
